_comment: Query-id overrides for the X GraphQL endpoints in lib/client/endpoints.dart. Apps fetch this on launch, so correcting an id here repairs every install without a release. Only ids for operations the installed build already knows are accepted, and only when they match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,32}$ — this file cannot redirect traffic or add endpoints. Keep entries while they differ from older shipped APKs; clear when every release already ships the same ids.
